snippet.title: Order: The New Dawn | Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
Order:The New Dawn is a colony management game that blends elements of space adventure. In this vast universe of the future, "you" will play as a legendary captain from the United Star Systems, facing harsh trials across deserts, snowfields, islands, lava fields, and other diverse terrains. By gathering resources, researching technologies, and constructing drive machines, you will build your base from scratch. But as threats emerge from the space wasteland known as the "Void Origin," where will you lead the fate of your colony?

Following the test in March this year, we will release the first PC DEMO during the Steam Next Fest in October!!! In this DEMO, we have focused on refining the game's environmental art, introducing a "3D + seamless zoom" star map and optimizing 3D effects across multiple star maps. Surface content has been significantly expanded with the addition of walls, floors, and a blueprint function. Visual effects such as explosions and flames have been revamped, and dynamic water effects have been newly implemented.
